title: Tail Current Noise Suppression in RF CMOS VCOs

function_summary: Tail Current Noise Suppression in RF CMOS VCOs: This paper presents the experimental results of two different techniques, inductive degeneration and capacitive filtering, for reducing the phase noise in tail-biased RF CMOS voltage-controlled oscillators (VCOs).
